phase: the data volume device - still not readable from user space
result: STILL FAILING, but two real bugs were found and fixed

fixed_this_round.what: d_psize returned a block count instead of a sector size
fixed_this_round.detail: set_blocksize() stores d_psize's answer in vp->v_specsize and spec_read() refuses the request when that exceeds PAGE_SIZE. xnusys_var_size returned 356352, so every read answered EINVAL before any request reached the driver. memdev's mdevsize() returns 512 and virtio_blk's blk_dev_size() returns 512; it now returns XNUSYS_SECTOR too.

fixed_this_round.what: one failed request poisoned the lease and locked the whole phone out of storage
fixed_this_round.detail: twoblock_fail() called us_poison() for every kind of failure, including ones where nothing had been issued at all -- a block with no measured reference, a slice that did not fit, an admission refusal. Poisoning means 'a command went out and the controller may not be back', so those cases are now twoblock_refuse() and leave the lease alone. A checksum mismatch still poisons, because there the command did go out and the data is wrong.
fixed_this_round.how_it_was_found: the regression test caught my first attempt at the split -- I had made the checksum path refuse as well, and corrupt_last asserted UR_POISONED

still_failing.symptom: the loader's guard says ownership was not returned, on the boot after these fixes
still_failing.what_is_known: the read handler is now reachable in principle (character node, D_DISK, physio into the strategy, d_psize corrected), but the phone still ended in the guard
still_failing.what_is_not_known: which of the remaining paths poisons, or whether the hang is somewhere else entirely
still_failing.next_step_that_would_settle_it: read the HLOG from a boot where the guard fired and see how far the driver got -- the log is the one piece of evidence not yet collected

my_process_failure: five flips, each confirmed by flashing rather than by reading the code first. The two bugs above were both visible in the source and were found by reading it, not by testing. The order should have been: read the call chain, then change one thing, then flash.
